    if level == 0:
        return 0 if value == 0 else 100000000
    if value < 0:
        value = -value

    res1 = recursive(level - 1, value - div * A[level]) + div * level
    res2 = recursive(level - 1, value - (div + 1) * A[level]) + (div + 1) * level
    return min(res1, res2)
